scope: Bounded flat-line full-cell laboratory; no production selection

tests.initialDirectedFailure: An incorrect test expected the legacy width/cadence configuration to refuse. It validly represents 400 cells and 80 steps on the old .1 s domain; the new domain represents 128 cells and 8800 steps. The assertion was corrected before final-source validation.

limitations: Bounded full-cell manufactured wave only; not unrestricted long-time stability.
Affine pressure is semidiscrete-exact in the qualified fixture; spatial convergence remains open.
Initial face-zero tiny first-step traces are retained without a detection floor.
The narrower domain changes RMS normalization; do not compare directly with the old domain.
No model pins, spherical/seasonal integration, desktop selection or serialized checkpoint support changes.
